Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 71: June 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #71 shipped to subscribers in May 2007 (bearing the cover date of June 2007 for Issue 71). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #71 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trial games, and exclusive media content:

Forza Motorsport 2 (sim-style racing)
Tenchu Z (stealth ninja action)
Shadowrun (cross-platform tactical multiplayer FPS)
Monster Madness: Battle for Suburbia (top-down multiplayer action brawler)
Catan (Xbox Live Arcade digital board game adaptation)
Eets: Chowdown (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes, gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Halo 3, BioShock, Assassins Creed, and Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
